title: Template-Free Dynamic Invariant Detection
title_zh: 无需模板的动态不变式检测

paragraphs.en: Oca利用LLM提出动态不变式替代固定模板，配合插桩策略避免副作用和死循环，不变式更具表达力且成本远低于Daikon。 A dynamic invariant detector proposes invariants, such as method pre- and postconditions, and rules out those that do not hold at run time. Traditional detectors propose invariants from a fixed library of templates, which limits their expressiveness. A large language model (LLM) can propose invariants instead of, or in addition to, template-derived ones. With the right prompt and context choices, we found that this idea can both improve the invariants' expressiveness and reduce the cost of inferring the invariants. Greater expressiveness brings complications: an LLM-proposed invariant can execute arbitrary code during invariant evaluation, causing side effects or infinite loops. Our novel instrumentation strategies mitigate these problems. We wrap each candidate and evaluate only one invariant per thread at a time, so nested invariant evaluations cannot trigger one another indefinitely. To recover from non-nested hangs, we monitor each run for stalls and retry it under a growing time budget. Because we cannot prove a candidate side-effect-free in advance, we use delta debugging over the invariants evaluated during a failing test to isolate and disable a side-effecting candidate without discarding the rest of the run. We compared our implementation, Oca, to the popular template-based Daikon invariant detector on real open-source Java projects. Oca produces more expressive invariants: on average, 28% of its held invariants call a project-specific method, which Daikon's templates cannot express. Its invariants are more often valid, with a false-positive rate of 18% in a manual inspection, vs. 76% for Daikon, and more useful: as properties for property-based testing, they exposed 9 of 25 real bugs, compared with 4 for Daikon. Oca also costs less, using 566 minutes and 27 GB of disk, compared with 2,817 minutes and 827 GB for Daikon.
paragraphs.zh: Oca利用LLM提出动态不变式替代固定模板，配合插桩策略避免副作用和死循环，不变式更具表达力且成本远低于Daikon。 动态不变式检测器会提出不变式，例如方法的前置条件和后置条件，并在运行时排除不成立的不变式。 传统的检测器从固定的模板库中提出不变式，这限制了不变式的表达力。 大语言模型（LLM）可以代替模板推导提出不变式，或者在模板推导的基础上补充提出不变式。 我们发现，只要选择合适的提示词和上下文，这一思路既能提升不变式的表达力，又能降低推导不变式的成本。 更强的表达力也带来了复杂性：LLM提出的不变式在求值时可能执行任意代码，从而引发副作用或死循环。 我们新颖的插桩策略缓解了这些问题。 我们对每个候选不变式进行包装，并且每个线程一次只求值一个不变式，因此嵌套的不变式求值不会无限地相互触发。 为了从非嵌套的挂起中恢复，我们监控每次运行是否停滞，并在不断增长的时间预算下进行重试。 由于我们无法事先证明某个候选不变式没有副作用，我们对失败测试中求值过的不变式使用增量调试，以隔离并禁用有副作用的候选不变式，而不丢弃该次运行的其余结果。 我们将我们的实现Oca与流行的基于模板的Daikon不变式检测器在真实的开源Java项目上进行了比较。 Oca产出的不变式更具表达力：平均而言，其成立的不变式中有28%调用了项目特定的方法，而Daikon的模板无法表达这类不变式。 其不变式更常有效，人工检查中的误报率为18%，而Daikon为76%，且更有用：作为基于属性的测试中的属性，它们暴露了25个真实缺陷中的9个，而Daikon只暴露了4个。 Oca的成本也更低，仅使用566分钟和27 GB磁盘空间，而Daikon需要2817分钟和827 GB。
